props.animation_script:
(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return]";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const DEBUG = true;

const SOUND_SRC = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_manto.wav";

const SOUND_VOLUME = 0.5;

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 320;

const HOLD_MS = 1500; // wait after SFX before running back

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 320;

const APPROACH_GAP = 70;

function dbg(...args) {

if (!DEBUG) return;

console.log(TAG, ...args);

}

function warn(...args) {

console.warn(TAG, ...args);

}

function err(...args) {

console.error(TAG, ...args);

}

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, eventPayload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, eventPayload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload: eventPayload });

};

}

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref === "string") {

const byId = canvas.tokens?.get(ref);

if (byId) return byId;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc;

} catch (e) {

warn("toTokenPlaceable failed fromUuid:", ref, e);

return null;

}

}

return ref.object ?? ref.token?.object ?? ref ?? null;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean))];

}

function summarizeToken(tok) {

if (!tok) return null;

return {

id: tok.id ?? null,

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

uuid: tok.document?.uuid ?? null,

center: tok.center ? { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y } : null,

x: tok.x ?? null,

y: tok.y ?? null

};

}

async function resolveSourceToken() {

const candidates = [

payload.casterTokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenUuid,

payload.performerTokenUuid,

payload.tokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

];

dbg("resolveSourceToken candidates:", candidates);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveTargetTokens() {

const raw = uniq([

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetTokenUuids) ? payload.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetUUIDs) ? payload.targetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.originalTargetUUIDs) ? payload.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : []),

...(Array.from(game.user?.targets ?? []).map(t => t?.document?.uuid))

]);

dbg("resolveTargetTokens raw refs:", raw);

const out = [];

for (const r of raw) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(r);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

return out;

}

let resolvedSourceToken = null;

let resolvedTargets = [];

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();

const targets = await resolveTargetTokens();

const firstTarget = targets[0] ?? null;

resolvedSourceToken = sourceToken;

resolvedTargets = targets;

dbg("Resolved source token:", summarizeToken(sourceToken));

dbg("Resolved targets:", targets.map(summarizeToken));

dbg("Payload snapshot:", payload);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

return;

}

if (!firstTarget) {

ui.notifications.warn("No target token found.");

return;

}

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function getNativeFlipX(token) {

const values = [

token?.document?.texture?.scaleX,

token?.mesh?.scale?.x,

token?.icon?.scale?.x

].filter(v => typeof v === "number");

if (values.some(v => v < 0)) return true;

const mirrorX = token?.document?.texture?.mirrorX;

if (typeof mirrorX === "boolean") return mirrorX;

return false;

}

function setSpriteFlipX(sprite, flipped) {

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

sprite.scale.x = flipped ? -sx : sx;

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const home = { x: token.center.x, y: token.center.y };

sprite.x = home.x;

sprite.y = home.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

sprite.alpha = baseObj.worldAlpha ?? 1;

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, getNativeFlipX(token));

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const originalFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

const target = targetTokens?.[0] ?? null;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

let front = {

x: home.x + Number(params.fallbackDx ?? -120),

y: home.y

};

if (target) {

const targetCenter = target.center ?? { x: home.x, y: home.y };

const approachDir = home.x >= targetCenter.x ? 1 : -1;

const gap = Number(

params.approachGap ??

Math.max(casterToken.w ?? 100, target.w ?? 100) * 0.6

);

front = {

x: targetCenter.x + (approachDir * gap),

y: targetCenter.y

};

}

// Run in

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

// Hold while the external SFX window plays

if (Number(params.holdMs ?? 0) > 0) {

await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 0));

}

// Flip for the run back

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, !originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

dbg("Starting pseudo movement session.");

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn.flipAware",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [firstTarget.document.uuid],

params: {

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

holdMs: HOLD_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

approachGap: APPROACH_GAP,

fallbackDx: sourceToken.center.x >= firstTarget.center.x ? -120 : 120,

zIndex: 5000

},

meta: {

source: "RunFrontSfxReturn",

soundSrc: SOUND_SRC

}

});

// Sequencer handles SFX only.

dbg("Starting Sequencer SFX.");

const sfxSeq = new Sequence();

sfxSeq

.wait(MOVE_OUT_MS)

.sound()

.file(SOUND_SRC)

.volume(SOUND_VOLUME);

sfxSeq.play();

// Wait for the whole cinematic window before ending.

await wait(MOVE_OUT_MS + HOLD_MS + MOVE_BACK_MS + 80);

dbg("Animation wait window finished.");

} catch (e) {

err("Animation crashed:", e);

} finally {

try {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

dbg("Emitted oni:animationEnd.", {

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to emit animationEnd:", e);

}

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
// ============================================================================

// Soul Steal — Custom Logic (Resolution) v8

// UPDATE:

// - Supports a global "(Empty)" item result.

// - Empty result is detected by:

// 1) exact UUID match: Item.SUYqRKHBGXUhiOL1

// 2) resolved item doc name == "(Empty)"

// 3) raw loot text == "(Empty)"

// - If empty result is picked:

// -> route to "Nothing to steal"

// -> STILL mark target as stolen = true

// - Otherwise keep normal steal behavior the same.

// ============================================================================

const TAG = "[ONI][SoulSteal][CL-RES]";

const DEBUG = true;

const EMPTY_ITEM_UUID = "Item.SUYqRKHBGXUhiOL1";

const EMPTY_ITEM_NAME = "(Empty)";

const log = (...a) => DEBUG && console.log(TAG, ...a);

const warn = (...a) => DEBUG && console.warn(TAG, ...a);

const err = (...a) => DEBUG && console.error(TAG, ...a);

function toNum(v, fallback = 0) {

const n = Number(v);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

}

function parseWeight(v) {

if (typeof v === "number") return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0;

if (typeof v === "string") {

const m = v.match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?/);

return m ? toNum(m[0], 0) : 0;

}

return 0;

}

function safeName(doc, fallback = "—") {

return (doc?.name ?? doc?.actor?.name ?? fallback);

}

function extractItemIdFromUuidLike(s) {

const str = String(s ?? "");

const m = str.match(/\.Item\.([A-Za-z0-9]{10,})$/);

if (m) return m[1];

if (/^[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}$/.test(str)) return str;

return null;

}

function looksLikeResolvableUuid(s) {

const str = String(s ?? "").trim();

if (!str) return false;

// Good enough for ItemTransferCore.resolveItem via fromUuid:

// Actor.X.Item.Y, Item.Y, Compendium.pack.Item.Y, Scene...Token...Item...

if (str.includes(".Item.") || str.startsWith("Item.") || str.startsWith("Compendium.")) return true;

if (str.startsWith("Actor.") || str.startsWith("Scene.")) return true;

return false;

}

function normalizeEmptyName(s) {

return String(s ?? "")

.trim()

.replace(/\s+/g, " ")

.toLowerCase();

}

function isEmptyStealResult(picked, itemDoc = null) {

const pickedUuid = String(picked?.itemUuid ?? "").trim();

if (pickedUuid === EMPTY_ITEM_UUID) return true;

const docName = normalizeEmptyName(itemDoc?.name);

if (docName === normalizeEmptyName(EMPTY_ITEM_NAME)) return true;

const rawLootName = normalizeEmptyName(picked?.rawLoot);

if (rawLootName === normalizeEmptyName(EMPTY_ITEM_NAME)) return true;

return false;

}

function pickWeighted(entries) {

const total = entries.reduce((s, e) => s + Math.max(0, e.weight), 0);

if (!(total > 0)) return null;

let r = Math.random() * total;

for (const e of entries) {

r -= Math.max(0, e.weight);

if (r <= 0) return e;

}

return entries[entries.length - 1] ?? null;

}

// -------------------------

// Chat card builder (ItemAwarder CSS classes)

// -------------------------

function buildObtainCardHtml(rows) {

const card = document.createElement("div");

card.className = "oni-obtain-card";

for (const r of rows) {

const row = document.createElement("div");

row.className = "oni-obtain-row";

if (r.iconSrc) {

const img = document.createElement("img");

img.className = "oni-obtain-icon";

img.src = r.iconSrc;

img.alt = "";

row.appendChild(img);

} else {

const spacer = document.createElement("div");

spacer.style.width = "32px";

spacer.style.height = "32px";

row.appendChild(spacer);

}

const text = document.createElement("div");

text.className = "oni-obtain-text";

for (const n of (r.textNodes ?? [])) text.appendChild(n);

row.appendChild(text);

card.appendChild(row);

}

return card.outerHTML;

}

function nodeText(s) {

return document.createTextNode(String(s ?? ""));

}

function nodeItalic(s) {

const i = document.createElement("i");

i.textContent = String(s ?? "");

return i;

}

function nodeUuidLink(itemUuid, itemName) {

const span = document.createElement("span");

span.className = "oni-obtain-name";

span.textContent = "@UUID[" + String(itemUuid) + "]{" + String(itemName ?? "Item") + "}";

return span;

}

async function postObtainStyle(rows) {

const rawHtml = buildObtainCardHtml(rows);

// Ensure @UUID is enriched into a clickable link

const html = await TextEditor.enrichHTML(rawHtml, { async: true });

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

speaker: null,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

content: html,

flags: { core: { cssClass: "oni-obtain-msg" } }

});

}

async function postMissCannotSteal() {

await postObtainStyle([{ iconSrc: null, textNodes: [nodeItalic("Cannot steal anything...")] }]);

}

async function postNothingToSteal() {

await postObtainStyle([{ iconSrc: null, textNodes: [nodeItalic("Nothing to steal")] }]);

}

async function postStoleItem(itemUuid, itemName, itemImg) {

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: itemImg || null,

textNodes: [nodeText("Stole "), nodeUuidLink(itemUuid, itemName)]

}]);

}

// -------------------------

// Loot UUID resolver

// -------------------------

function resolveTemplateItemUuid(rawLoot, lootMap, targetActor) {

const key = String(rawLoot ?? "").trim();

if (!key) return null;

// 1) Already a real UUID

if (looksLikeResolvableUuid(key)) return key;

// 2) Direct lootMap key -> uuid

const direct = lootMap?.[key]?.uuid;

if (direct && looksLikeResolvableUuid(direct)) return String(direct).trim();

// 3) Try if key is an itemId on targetActor

if (targetActor?.items?.get(key)) return targetActor.items.get(key).uuid;

// 4) Try match by NAME inside lootMap values

if (lootMap) {

const low = normalizeEmptyName(key);

const byName = Object.values(lootMap).find(v =>

normalizeEmptyName(v?.name) === low && v?.uuid

);

if (byName?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(byName.uuid)) return String(byName.uuid).trim();

}

// 5) Try match by NAME on targetActor items

if (targetActor?.items) {

const low = normalizeEmptyName(key);

const it = targetActor.items.find(i => normalizeEmptyName(i?.name) === low);

if (it?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(it.uuid)) return it.uuid;

}

// 6) Try world items by exact name first

if (game?.items?.getName) {

const it = game.items.getName(key);

if (it?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(it.uuid)) return it.uuid;

}

// 7) Try world items by normalized name

if (game?.items) {

const low = normalizeEmptyName(key);

const it = game.items.find(i => normalizeEmptyName(i?.name) === low);

if (it?.uuid && looksLikeResolvableUuid(it.uuid)) return it.uuid;

}

return null;

}

// -------------------------

// Resolve payload + args

// -------------------------

const payload = (typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined") ? __PAYLOAD : null;

if (!payload) { err("No __PAYLOAD; abort."); return; }

const args = payload.__confirmArgs ?? {};

log("ARGS keys", Object.keys(args));

const targets = Array.isArray(payload?.targets) ? payload.targets : [];

if (!targets.length) { warn("No targets; nothing to do."); return; }

const attackerUuid = payload?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? args?.attackerUuid ?? null;

if (!attackerUuid) { err("No attackerUuid; abort.", { attackerUuid }); return; }

const targetUuid = targets[0];

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid).catch(() => null);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid).catch(() => null);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

log("START", {

attackerUuid,

attacker: safeName(attackerActor, "Unknown Attacker"),

targetUuid,

target: safeName(targetActor, "Unknown Target"),

});

// -------------------------

// 1) HIT / MISS CHECK (Soul Steal checks Magic Defense)

// -------------------------

const isHealing = /^(heal|healing|recovery|restore|restoration)$/i.test(String(args?.elementType ?? "physical"));

const hasAccuracy = (typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : true;

const accTotal = hasAccuracy ? toNum(args?.accuracyTotal, NaN) : NaN;

const explicitAutoHit =

(args?.autoHit === true) ||

(args?.advPayload?.autoHit === true) ||

(args?.advPayload?.isCrit === true);

const treatAutoHit = (!hasAccuracy) || explicitAutoHit;

function readMagicDefense(props) {

const p = props ?? {};

for (const k of ["magic_defense", "current_mdef", "mdef", "magicDef", "magic_def"]) {

const n = toNum(p[k], NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

for (const k of Object.keys(p)) {

if (!/magic/i.test(k)) continue;

if (!/def|resist|mdef/i.test(k)) continue;

const n = toNum(p[k], NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

return 0;

}

let isHit = true;

if (!isHealing && !treatAutoHit) {

const tProps = targetActor?.system?.props ?? {};

const mdef = readMagicDefense(tProps);

isHit = (Number.isFinite(mdef) && Number.isFinite(accTotal)) ? (accTotal >= mdef) : true;

log("HITCHECK", { accTotal, mdef, isHit });

} else {

log("HITCHECK", { isHealing, treatAutoHit, hasAccuracy, explicitAutoHit, isHit: true });

}

if (!isHit) {

log("MISS => feedback only");

await postMissCannotSteal();

return;

}

// -------------------------

// Read SL (apply IP after steal section)

// -------------------------

let pendingNewIP = null;

try {

const casterProps = attackerActor?.system?.props ?? {};

const curIP = toNum(casterProps?.current_ip, 0);

const maxIP = toNum(casterProps?.max_ip, curIP);

const soulStealItem =

attackerActor?.items?.find(i => String(i?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === "soul steal") ??

attackerActor?.items?.find(i => /soul\s*steal/i.test(String(i?.name ?? ""))) ??

null;

const SL = toNum(soulStealItem?.system?.props?.level, NaN);

const slFinal = Number.isFinite(SL) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(SL)) : 0;

pendingNewIP = Math.min(maxIP, curIP + slFinal);

log("IP (pending)", {

curIP,

maxIP,

SL: slFinal,

pendingNewIP,

soulStealItemId: soulStealItem?.id ?? null

});

} catch (e) {

err("IP read failed", e);

}

// -------------------------

// 2) Steal logic (gmToActor; do NOT remove item from target)

// -------------------------

if (!targetActor) {

warn("Target actor not resolved; cannot steal.");

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const tProps = targetActor.system?.props ?? {};

const alreadyStolen = !!tProps?.isStolen;

if (alreadyStolen) {

log("Target already isStolen => Nothing to steal");

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const lootMap = tProps?.stealable_loot ?? {};

const stealTable = tProps?.steal_percentage_table ?? {};

log("STEAL DATA snapshot", {

lootMapKeys: Object.keys(lootMap).length,

stealTableKeys: Object.keys(stealTable).length

});

const entries = [];

const rawRows = Object.values(stealTable ?? {});

log("STEAL TABLE rawRows", rawRows);

for (const row of rawRows) {

if (!row) continue;

if (typeof row === "object" && row.$deleted === true) continue;

let rawLoot = null;

let rawW = null;

if (typeof row === "string") {

rawLoot = row;

rawW = 1;

} else if (Array.isArray(row)) {

rawLoot = row[0];

rawW = row[1];

} else if (typeof row === "object") {

rawLoot = row.loot_id ?? row.lootUuid ?? row.loot_uuid ?? row.uuid ?? row.id ?? null;

rawW = row.loot_percentage ?? row.percentage ?? row.weight ?? row.chance ?? null;

}

const weight = parseWeight(rawW);

const rawLootStr = String(rawLoot ?? "").trim();

const templateUuid = resolveTemplateItemUuid(rawLootStr, lootMap, targetActor);

// HARD GUARD: never allow non-UUIDs into entries

if (!templateUuid || !looksLikeResolvableUuid(templateUuid)) {

warn("STEAL ROW skip (unresolvable loot_id)", { rawLoot: rawLootStr, templateUuid });

continue;

}

if (!(weight > 0)) continue;

entries.push({

itemUuid: templateUuid,

weight,

rawLoot: rawLootStr

});

log("STEAL ROW ok", { rawLoot: rawLootStr, weight, templateUuid });

}

log("STEAL entries parsed", entries);

if (!entries.length) {

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const picked = pickWeighted(entries);

if (!picked?.itemUuid) {

await postNothingToSteal();

} else {

const itemDoc = await fromUuid(picked.itemUuid).catch(() => null);

const itemName = itemDoc?.name ?? "Unknown Item";

const itemImg = itemDoc?.img ?? "";

if (isEmptyStealResult(picked, itemDoc)) {

log("STEAL picked EMPTY result => route to Nothing to steal + mark isStolen", {

pickedItemUuid: picked.itemUuid,

itemName,

rawLoot: picked?.rawLoot

});

try {

await postNothingToSteal();

await targetActor.update({ "system.props.isStolen": true });

log("EMPTY steal handled + isStolen set TRUE");

} catch (e) {

err("EMPTY steal handling failed", e);

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: null,

textNodes: [nodeItalic("Failed to process empty steal (see console)")]

}]);

}

} else {

const itc = window["oni.ItemTransferCore"];

if (!itc?.transfer) {

err('ItemTransferCore missing: window["oni.ItemTransferCore"].transfer');

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: null,

textNodes: [nodeItalic("Failed to steal (ItemTransferCore missing)")]

}]);

} else {

try {

log("GM AWARD begin (gmToActor)", {

templateItemUuid: picked.itemUuid,

receiver: attackerActor.uuid,

itemName

});

await itc.transfer({

mode: "gmToActor",

itemUuid: picked.itemUuid,

quantity: 1,

receiverActorUuid: attackerActor.uuid,

requestedByUserId: game.user?.id,

showTransferCard: false

});

await postStoleItem(picked.itemUuid, itemName, itemImg);

await targetActor.update({ "system.props.isStolen": true });

log("GM AWARD done + isStolen set TRUE");

} catch (e) {

err("GM AWARD failed", e);

await postObtainStyle([{

iconSrc: null,

textNodes: [nodeItalic("Failed to steal (see console)")]

}]);

}

}

}

}

}

}

}

// -------------------------

// 3) Apply IP recovery (after steal logic)

// -------------------------

try {

if (attackerActor && pendingNewIP !== null) {

const curIP2 = toNum(attackerActor.system?.props?.current_ip, 0);

if (pendingNewIP !== curIP2) {

await attackerActor.update({ "system.props.current_ip": pendingNewIP });

log("IP updated", { from: curIP2, to: pendingNewIP });

} else {

log("IP unchanged", { curIP: curIP2 });

}

}

} catch (e) {

err("IP update failed", e);

}
props.description:
You may use an action to perform a 【DEX + WLP】 Check against the Magic Defense of a creature you can see. if you succeed and the target is a soldier, you recover 【SL】 Inventory Points.

Additionally, if they are an elite or champion, the GM gives you the target’s soul treasure, an item worth an amount of zenit equal to or lower than【the target's level multiplied by 30, or by 50 if they are a Villain】. This soul treasure will appear inside your backpack;

a creature can be successfully stolen from with this Skill only once.
